body.claim: exagium_seccomp uses a syscall denylist ending in SECCOMP_RET_ALLOW rather than an allowlist.
body.expected: Candidate C inference and training should run under an explicit syscall allowlist with default EPERM/KILL.
body.actual: Any Linux syscall not explicitly listed in the denylist is permitted by SECCOMP_RET_ALLOW.
